critical_code_review_comments: sharePdfOnWeb correctly gates on navigator.canShare({files}) before calling navigator.share; on Android Chrome >=89 this will open the native share sheet directly (WhatsApp/Mail/Drive) as intended. Desktop browsers without file-share capability will hit the <a download> fallback.
Consider surfacing a user-visible message when the fallback download path is used, so the user knows why the share sheet didn't appear (e.g. on desktop browsers). Not a blocker.
jsPDF page height is fixed via estimated formula; if a bill has many items the last lines could overflow. Non-blocking for this fix.
